description: Get the script that adds the Weav AI chat widget to the user's website, with install instructions. Share it with the user or their developer. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

name: get_chat_widget_install
title: Get chat widget install code
